Class ParkingSlot

java.lang.Object
ParkingSlot
public class ParkingSlot extends Object
One parking slot of the car park. A slot has an identifier (one capital letter followed by three digits, e.g. "S001"), a type (staff or visitor) and may hold one parked car.
Version:
1.0

    • ParkingSlot

      public ParkingSlot(String slotId, String slotType)
      Creates an empty parking slot.
      Parameters:
      slotId - identifier, one capital letter followed by 3 digits
      slotType - either STAFF or VISITOR (case is ignored)
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the identifier or type is invalid

      public void parkCar(Car car)
      Parks a car in this slot and records the current time in the car.
      Parameters:
      car - the car to park (not null)
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the car is null
      IllegalStateException - if the slot is occupied, or the car's type (staff/visitor) does not match the slot type
